mono.usage: Data points, IDs, Logs, Code blocks

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid, ultra-subtle. Never use thick borders.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal to zero. Use surface color steps instead of shadows for elevation. For popovers/modals, use a very diffuse shadow like shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] in light mode and shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.12)] in dark mode.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: Rounded-md (6px) or rounded-lg (8px) for cards and inputs. Sharp and crisp.
visual_enhancers.background_blur: backdrop-blur-md for sticky headers or floating elements.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only for floating command palettes or toast notifications.

layout_and_grids.sidebar: Fixed width 260px on desktop, collapsable to hamburger on mobile. Very clean list with Lucide icons.
layout_and_grids.topbar: Sticky, contains Test Mode/Sandbox banner, Language selector (FR/EN), Theme Toggle, and User Profile.
layout_and_grids.page_container: Max-width container, p-6 to p-10 depending on screen size. High density, meaning less empty whitespace than consumer apps.
layout_and_grids.grids: Bento style or dense grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 for KPI cards and Agent Cards.

motion.transitions: Fast and snappy. 150ms ease-out for hovers.
motion.page_transitions: Subtle fade-in and slide-up (translate-y-2 to translate-y-0).
motion.hover_states: Background color shifts for list items. Slight border color change for cards.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded. Primary buttons are solid inverted (black in light mode, white in dark mode). Secondary buttons are outlined or ghost.
components.cards: Flat, 1px border. No hover elevation, only border color change on hover.
components.tables: Edge-to-edge feeling within their container. Flush rows. Density: compact (py-2 or py-3).
components.forms: Inputs have subtle borders, focus ring is a thin primary color ring (ring-1 ring-primary).
components.badges: Used for statuses (Active, Draft, Sent, Qualified). Very subtle background tint.
components.kill_switch: A distinct, prominent button in red/destructive color to stop all agent activities instantly.
components.test_mode_banner: A slim, top-of-screen banner indicating 'Test Mode / Sandbox' with a warning color (orange/yellow tint).

key_pages_requirements.Dashboard: KPI grid at the top (Active Agents, Prospects Found, Meetings, etc.). Below: Grid of Agent Cards (Prospect AI is active, others 'Coming soon').
key_pages_requirements.Prospect_AI_Dashboard: Search Form with multiple sections (Target, Location, Sources, Advanced Filters accordion, AI analysis toggle, Service type). A Data Table for prospects with sorting, filtering, selection, bulk actions.
key_pages_requirements.Prospect_Details: A side-panel or separate page showing Prospect Profile, AI Analysis Score (0-100 gauge/progress bar), Opportunities detected, and AI Message Generator with tabs for Email/Phone/LinkedIn/WhatsApp.
key_pages_requirements.Security_Center: A clean list of toggle switches (Human Validation, Send Limits, Delays, Blacklist, Opt-out).
key_pages_requirements.Analytics: Recharts based graphs (Bar chart for prospects by day, Pie chart for sectors, etc.).
key_pages_requirements.Activity_Log: A timeline or detailed table showing Date, Time, Agent, Action, Result.
key_pages_requirements.Integrations: Grid of simple cards with logos/icons for OpenAI, Gmail, Google Sheets, SMTP, CRM, Make, Zapier.
key_pages_requirements.Settings: Forms for AI Provider, Model, Creativity (slider), Language, Budget limits.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA and WCAG AA compliance.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus-visible rings.
accessibility.keyboard: Implement keyboard navigation for tables and forms.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI in React using standard .js files for React components, but properly utilize Tailwind and shadcn concepts.
Maintain high density in the layout. Do not over-pad the dashboard cards. Use text-sm for most of the UI and text-xs for secondary metadata.
Use Lucide icons for all integrations (e.g., Mail for Gmail, Database for CRM, Bot for OpenAI) if exact brand logos are missing.
Implement a language toggle (FR/EN) in the top nav using a simple Select or DropdownMenu component.
Implement a Theme toggle for Light/Dark mode.
Always add a 'data-testid' to interactive elements for testing.
Use Sonner for any toast notifications (e.g., saving settings, copying messages).
DO NOT use raw transparent backgrounds on overlays. Always use solid background colors or backdrop-blur with a semi-transparent background.
